commits.message:
feat(hermes-drafts): review queue UI for Hermes email-parsed drafts

Frontend for the Core-side draft review queue built in
jobFynder-BE-nestJS (src/hermes-drafts/, /api/hermes-drafts) -- until
now that API had no UI, so bench_sales/crm_admin would have had to call
it directly.

- src/services/hermes-drafts.ts: typed client for list/get/approve-job/
  dismiss, mirroring the backend's exact response shapes.
- src/pages/private/HermesDraftsReview.tsx: list of pending drafts on the
  left, detail panel on the right. For a draft_job_requirement, the
  detail panel is an editable form pre-filled from the backend's
  suggestedJob (title, description, skills, work auth, employment
  types) -- required fields the backend didn't fabricate (employment
  type, job title length) are validated client-side before the Approve
  button will submit, with a message explaining why. Every other draft
  type shows the raw extracted payload read-only with just a Dismiss
  action, matching the backend's own scope decision not to auto-create
  records for those types yet.
- Route /email-intake-review, gated via the existing RoleBasedRoute to
  ["bench_sales", "crm_admin"] (same pattern as /pulse's
  ["recruiter","bench_sales"] gating).
- Added a nav entry (src/constants/navigation.ts, id 10, Mail icon,
  same allowedRoles) so the page is actually discoverable rather than a
  URL nobody knows about.

Note: DraftObject has no timestamp field on the Hermes side, so the
list has no chronological sort -- flagged as a real limitation, not
silently ordered by something arbitrary and left unexplained.

Verified: `tsc -b` produces the identical error set with and without
this change (12 pre-existing errors, all in unrelated test files/
ClickConnectorWidget -- confirmed via git stash diff, none reference
these new files). `eslint` clean on all 4 changed/added files. NOT
verified in a live browser -- doing so would require standing up
login + role mocking + backend mock endpoints for /api/hermes-drafts
from scratch in this environment, which wasn't done; this follows the
same component/service patterns (Button/Badge/Input/Textarea/Label,
apiRequest, useToastStore) already browser-verified elsewhere this
session, but that is not the same as verifying this specific page.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
